disease_label_per_paper: Acute Q fever in third trimester pregnancy presenting with fever, headache, thrombocytopenia, and hepatitis
presentation_summary: 29-year-old gravida 2 para 1 woman at 29 weeks gestation presented with fevers and back pain; the patient perspective also describes fevers and headaches.
Blood collected on day 5 of illness showed thrombocytopenia and hepatitis: platelets 134 x10^9/L, ALT 464 U/L, AST 323 U/L, and CRP 112 mg/L.
Q fever PCR detected Coxiella burnetii DNA from blood collected at presentation, and paired serology later confirmed acute Q fever.

She started oral clarithromycin empirically, changed to trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole after PCR returned positive, stopped TMP-SMX after a delayed cutaneous reaction, then continued clarithromycin until term delivery of a healthy infant.

quality_warnings: Coxiella serology is confirmatory and not used as ordinary presentation evidence.
